title: Cyberpunk 2077
provenance: user reports on Highball (highball-db#2 M4, #3 M5, OdynOOb), wine-10.0 Sikarugir r6; previously community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming). amenocturne (highball-db#500, 2026-10-15), Apple M3 Max, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.10.10, the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r12, DXMT, scale 120 dpi, DLL overrides version=n,b;winmm=n,b, recipes steam, cyberpunk-2077 and vcrun2022, rated 4 of 5 after 76 minutes: 50 to 80 fps in the benchmark on mid to high settings without ray tracing, 40 to 60 in play, stutter from shader compilation that settles. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Playable. M4: ~17 fps avg, 1920x1200 Steam Deck preset + FSR 2.1. M5: 60-82 fps in gameplay (Metal HUD; the built-in benchmark's summary under-reads because of first-frames shader compilation), fullscreen 1920x1200, FSR 2.1 Balanced, ray-traced local shadows ON. Mandatory: Advertise AVX ON (engine crashes at launch otherwise); Steam launch option --launcher-skip (REDlauncher fails on OpenGL context / libEGL.dll); Steam Overlay OFF (black screen). Fullscreen beats borderless for frame pacing. First runs stutter while shaders compile, then settle. See recipe cyberpunk-2077.

nativeMac.where: Steam, Mac App Store, GOG, Epic
nativeMac.note: The Ultimate Edition has a native Apple Silicon build (macOS 15.5, M1, 16 GB RAM) released 17 July 2025. It will beat the Windows build through a translation layer.
